title: Plant
description: A solar power plant in a vendor's fleet. Returned as an element of `plant_list` and as a field reference in other tools.

id.description: Globally unique plant identifier. MUST be prefixed with the vendor name to avoid collision across multi-vendor fleets (e.g. `SG-12345`, `HW-67890`).

vendor.description: Vendor name (lowercase, kebab-case). MUST match the vendor's MCP server registration name. Used by the fleet adapter for routing.

name.description: Human-readable plant name. Often Chinese or local-language for region-specific deployments.

capacity_kwp.description: Installed DC capacity in kilowatts-peak. Used for yield-normalization and equivalent-hours calculations.

install_date.description: ISO-8601 date when the plant came online. Used for performance-degradation baselines.

location.description: Optional geo-location. Useful for irradiance estimation and time-zone routing.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier, e.g. `Asia/Shanghai`. Required for accurate day-boundary alignment in yield reporting.

status.description: Optional rollup status. If present, mirrors `PlantNow.status`.
